memo.memo_markdown:
# Next-quarter product effort: prioritize usability

Prioritize usability, especially disruptive ads and missing controls. It leads the actionable product areas in the saved totals: usability has 13 complaints and severity sum 37, compared with playback at 8 and 28, and billing/support at 9 and 26. Keep playback reliability under focused investigation because the #1 baseline issue, PLB-99, is a playback catch-all with 6 complaints, severity sum 21, and priority score 21 [C1][C2][C3].

## Why
USB-01, excessive ad interruptions, has 7 complaints and severity sum 20 [C4][C5]. USB-02, missing playback controls, adds 3 complaints and severity sum 9 [C6][C7]. The evidence includes complaints about frequent ads and removed controls. PLB-99 is important, but its broad definition combines failures, connection problems, audio quality, and other concerns; the evidence likewise spans different playback problems. Treat it as a baseline signal to diagnose, not a single feature prescription.

## Alternatives considered
**Playback:** PLB-99 ranks first, but it is a catch-all, and playback's area totals are below usability's. Investigate the underlying reports as follow-up work.

**Billing/support:** Its area totals are lower than usability's. BIL-03 identifies premium-gated controls, but does not outweigh the broader usability signal in the saved aggregates.

**Other:** The area has 15 complaints and severity sum 30, but OTH-99 is general dissatisfaction without a named product problem. Include it in the totals, but do not treat it as a specific feature workstream.

## Evidence
PLB-99 reports include crashes, connection problems, and songs stopping (55cc3abf-c295-4591-8c3a-78085cfdefaa; 4ab2089a-ffa8-49e7-a8a3-aeb583a96796; 6c257eba-3dca-49f6-b7f0-4c4484d81e26). USB-01 reviews cite frequent or loud ads (e5e6c55f-3069-4b7c-9807-f8b5d5bf2726; 3e8bdc92-4934-457e-85cc-8b9d14bf51c0). USB-02 reports describe removed controls (9e5f9745-f8be-48d3-b9de-4d118507d94a; 7084ced1-0428-4093-9328-442f74719b4f).

## Limitations
These are self-selected, historical reviews from the supplied classification scope, covering 2022-06-02 to 2023-11-13; they do not establish current prevalence or causality. Cancellation language is expressed intent, not observed churn. The facts report no quarantined or pending-unclassified records, but conclusions remain limited to the classified records and taxonomy. Catch-alls obscure the specific problems behind some complaints.

ranked_issues.name: Other playback complaints
ranked_issues.definition: playback complaints that fit none of the specific playback issues (Playback failure, crashes, freezing, lag, songs stopping or skipping by themselves, connection failures, audio quality, battery/data/storage use.)

ranked_issues.name: Excessive Ad Interruptions
ranked_issues.definition: Free listening is interrupted by ads too frequently or with disruptive volume, making continuous music playback difficult.

ranked_issues.name: General dissatisfaction (no specific feature)
ranked_issues.definition: Complaints that name no specific product problem, e.g. 'worst app', insults or vague anger

ranked_issues.name: Other catalog complaints
ranked_issues.definition: catalog complaints that fit none of the specific catalog issues (Missing songs or artists, removed content, search and discovery, recommendations, lyrics availability, podcasts content.)

ranked_issues.name: Premium-Gated Playback Controls
ranked_issues.definition: Basic playback controls such as playing the next or previous song, queueing tracks, or seeking within a song are unavailable without Premium.

ranked_issues.name: Forced Shuffle on Free Tier
ranked_issues.definition: Free users are unable to directly choose and play a specific song because playback is forced into shuffle or a playlist.

ranked_issues.name: Missing Playback Controls
ranked_issues.definition: Updates remove or restrict controls such as seeking, repeating, or playing a specific part of a song.

ranked_issues.name: Other access complaints
ranked_issues.definition: access complaints that fit none of the specific access issues (Login, signup, password or account access problems (e.g. 'can't log in', 'account hacked', 'logged out every day').)

ranked_issues.name: Update degraded app experience
ranked_issues.definition: Complaints that a recent update made the app worse, disappointing, or unusable belong here.

ranked_issues.name: Other downloads complaints
ranked_issues.definition: downloads complaints that fit none of the specific downloads issues (Downloading songs, saved music, offline listening, downloads disappearing.)

ranked_issues.name: Other billing complaints
ranked_issues.definition: billing complaints that fit none of the specific billing issues (Price, charges, subscriptions, refunds, paywalls, premium entitlement; controls explicitly limited to premium (e.g. 'can't pick songs without premium', 'only 6 skips') go here.)

ranked_issues.name: Disruptive Home Screen Changes
ranked_issues.definition: Home screen redesigns and automatically playing interface elements make browsing difficult or lack clear controls to disable them.

inputs.ranking_rule: priority_score = complaint_count x mean_severity = severity_sum; ties by issue_id
